verdict.rationale: Aleph's own docs claim drill-down within its Excel/Sheets reporting workflows and a single source of truth that keeps reports in sync. That is a first-party mechanism for tracing report numbers to underlying data. Its AI agent also returns answers with clickable, cited sources traceable to the source of truth, though that covers agent answers rather than report figures. The claims are one-line marketing mentions and never describe tracing through formulas. missing for 10: documented formula-level lineage/audit trail for report cells, detail on drill-down to individual source transactions/lines, independent or hands-on corroboration.
